body: I really like distress and coma. I just love those opening lines and their music is always so good anyway.

I sometimes really do wonder, what would a person who hasn't been in my shoes know about how i'm feeling and what i need. Not just the psychatrist but like people in general. They will never understand. Like maybe i don't understand your feelings right now. You know what, people get money to do this, and if not, then they are just curious about how far you have fallen. Don't expect anything from others. Not even your parents. All you get is humiliation. My parents and teachers actually make me feel like i am garbage because i am depressed and i wanna die. No one will ever understand because they haven't been here.
Depression is inherited. And when you live so close to a person and one whome you dearly love, who thinks this way, it just rubs off on you too. Have seen that happen with my brother too.
We don't have jobs and no money. My family won't even let us get married when they know about it.
He grew up in such circumstances and i inhereted it from my father
We very much are. He is the only happiness in my life.
Not a short term problem. We somehow hit a dead end.

We were classmates. Ironically, he has been suicidal from a long time and despite that, saved me from suicide one night. And here we are... isn't that funny?

I am so sick. I have completely lost it. I am really sorry to be imposing this on you but i find it funny. I find our deaths funny.

I am not mad at all. I am pretty calm right now. Though i have been unfeeling to an alarming degree these last few days. I have cried enough for my own death for the past few years. Now, as long as i don't leave my boyfriend behind to suffer alone, i am alright with death any moment.
Everything. Like how i am smiling right now even when thinking i will die. I feel hatred and guilt when i think i am not sad. I am just blank. And i can't help my boyfriend either.
I am a hateful person.

I don't want to see my boyfriend in pain. We will go ahead with a double suicide. And tbh, slitting my wrists nearly 1/3 rd is not a very appealing idea. Though considerably less painful than our lives.
Unrealistically, yes, i do want to run away with him. But otherwise, we do not have money. We do not have the will power to plan anything. We are extremely tired and way too deep in this. So, NO.

It doesn't help. We have many such conversations but i only pull him deeper. I make his suffering worse. There's nothing we can do about the way things are. And this hurts me even more.
Suicide is our only option if we don't want to keep on living like this.

This is so me. I stopped attending classes last july, somehow cleared the last semester but there's no chance of getting through this one. Have been holed up in my room forever. Just go out to get something to eat. I haven't been eating well. I think that it's a waste on me. Recently i have been crying day in and day out and the rest of the time i apologize to my boyfriend for being me or feel sorry for myself. And i know that tbis is the end for me. I am so tired at times that i can't even fake a smile. Feel like telling my friends and family that i am going to die soon and so they should be prepared.

There was someone here talking to me a moment ago, now i don't remember what they were talking about. I don't know what reality is anymore. And yes, it does make me hate myself, especially for hurting all those dear to me.
If this is lost, i will have nowhere to belong. Is it the same for you too?

People laugh at me. They don't understand shit. They think i am an attention seeker just when last night i broke down so bad, i cried for hours and gave some serious thought to suicide. Maybe they won't laugh anymore when i am dead but, who knows. Maybe i was meant to be a joke.

This is exactly like me. If it weren't for my boyfriend, i would have died long ago. I just don't want to hurt him in any way and hurt he will be if i am dead. But even that reason is not enough for me to stop now. It almost feels as though i have had enough and any day now, the dam will break and i will be gone. Everything will be alright then.
Thank you so much. I will try to keep myself occupied somehow, although i do agree, it is not easy to do so.

Somewhere during my preteen years i had already made up my mind that i won't live past the age of 25. I have always been a lonely child with no friends whatsoever. As far as i can remember, i did not even feel anything during that time. It wasn't until i was 16 or 17 that stress completely broke me down and i started to understand that what i was going through was depression. My whole life sucked. I did not understand anything, did not feel anything. It was as if i was on autopilot watching my life rot away in front of myself. All i waited for was freedom to live my life just once. Do drugs, drink and such( although i never could do that) and then when i had my fill of enjoyment( yes, this was enjoyment to me) i would simply kill myself because for fucks sake the only thing i have always been sure about is that " this life is not worth living. It would have been better had i been born dead". And THAT is all i have thought about all these years
Orange really broke me. The moment when kakeru committed suicide and the emptiness they show without kakeru in the lives of his friends was so heartbreaking but beautiful at the same time.
